verdict.rationale: The solo2 repo documents an official `solo2` CLI that lists connected devices, sets admin options such as the LED, and runs a verified firmware `update`, so the core of CLI-based management exists. The bit-rot probe concerns the Solo 1 `solo-python` tool (solo1-cli), so it does not concretely contradict the solo2 CLI, though it lowers confidence. Wiping relies on the third-party `fido2-token`, which earns no credit. missing for 10: enabling/disabling applications, PIN setting, slot management (OATH/PIV/OpenPGP), richer device-state reads, documented scripting/machine-readable output, independent hands-on corroboration of the solo2 CLI working

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure and manage the key from an official CLI — enable applications, set PINs, manage slots, read device state — scriptably

citations.quote: solo2 app admin set led 007f7f 00007f # set led to teal (idle) / blue (active) - use 000000 to turn the led off
solo2 list                   # list connected devices  (alias: solo2 ls)
`update` downloads the signed release, **verifies its SHA-256**, and flashes it.
